name: Sci-Hub
snippet: Sci-Hub has the largest (> 88 million documents) database of full-text scientific papers, available for free. Approximately 80% of the collection are articles from scientific journals, most of them dedicated to the subject of medicine.

name: Google Dorks Cheat Sheet — OSINT Operator Reference
snippet: Google Dorking for OSINT: The Complete Operator Reference & Investigation Playbook (2026) Every working search operator across Google, Bing, Yandex, DuckDuckGo, and Brave — with cross-engine compatibility tables, real-world OSINT investigation patterns, a graveyard of deprecated operators, and analysis of how AI search engines are changing dorking forever.

name: FIELDCRAFT #003 — THE PUBLIC RECORD
snippet: The federal court system’s electronic records database. Over one billion documents across all federal district courts, appellate courts, and bankruptcy courts. Search by party name to find any federal litigation involving your subject. Registration is free. Access costs $0.10 per page, but fees are waived if you accrue less than $30 in a quarter.

name: Security Lapse at Veritone AI Exposes Vast Amounts of US Govt
snippet: Cybersecurity firm UpGuard has reported that Veritone Inc., an AI technology provider, inadvertently exposed around 550GB of sensitive US government data. This massive security lapse involved approximately 1.664 billion documents on two unsecured Elasticsearch servers, discovered on March 23 and 24, 2024.
